title: Retry transient Unix group-cleanup failures within the original deadline
outcome: Retry transient Unix group-cleanup failures within the original deadline
acceptance: Transient macOS group-signal EPERM while members are exiting, and transient enumeration failures such as sysctl ENOMEM/EINTR, can be retried until the original cleanup deadline without reporting success before complete terminal-member verification.
Behavioral checks cover transient recovery and deadline exhaustion; permanent observation/ownership failures remain fail-closed and the group id stays reserved until proven safe to reap.
